candidate_delta: Reserve the complete upcoming rectangle path append once while preserving geometry, validation, limit accounting and failure state; the exact final production diff must be pinned before launch.
latency_metric: metric_ns == total_ns: in-memory Document::open + compile_page + render; excludes file reads, output emission, process startup and destruction

quality.preflight: Attempt all76 side/cell outputs with the reused all-cell preflight; every arm must independently match zero-tolerance RGB and opaque alpha and all38 same-mode pairs must match byte-for-byte. Aggregate numeric/render failures; cancellation/provenance/cleanup/budget failures remain fatal. No carried baseline mismatch or tolerance relaxation.

fixtures.scope: Frozen independent analytic19 references; image sampling policies are explicit fixture models, not arbitrary PDF or continuous-scene correctness.

environment.scope: Known-process polling; no OS-level exclusivity and no cold-filesystem claim

limits.scope: Retained PDFs/oracles/output blobs only; checkpoints and coordination evidence additional

decision.pilot: Exploratory only; never accepts. Proceed to one fixed fresh confirmation only after independent accuracy and complete pilot review.
decision.all_gates: All4 target latency gates (median upper<=0.95,p95 upper<=1), all34 protected median/p95 uppers<=1.02, all38 observed max-RSS ratios<=1, every quality/resource/error/state requirement, and completed required validation. This remains separate from the full release matrix.
decision.partial: Only after completed fresh confirmation: at least1 primary-mode median upper<1; no cell median orp95 lower>1.02; any observed peak-RSS ratio>1.05 blocks retention pending evidence-based investigation. Coordinator explicitly decides after all validation and disclosures. Secondary benefit alone does not qualify. All upper-bound misses,RSS misses and supported regressions remain visible. No automatic retention or full-admission claim.
decision.reject: Independent RGB/alpha/pair-byte, error, resource or state regression blocks retention. Provenance failure, postlaunch contamination, cancellation or incomplete matrix gives no admission and no automatic replacement trial. Any cell latency lower>1.02 blocks partial retention; a mere upper-bound miss is not proof of regression.
decision.sampling: No historical/pilot/invalid samples in confirmation, interim analysis, parameter tuning, optional stopping or automatic retry.

limitations: 19 bounded analytic pages do not establish performance on the full corpus.
Both modes use the same full-validation compile_page API; this is not the CLI render_context direct-image path.
200 pairs do not guarantee p95 precision, temporal independence or simultaneous familywise coverage.
Allcells cold-operation only; stage metrics are descriptive and cannot replace the frozen total metric.
No speedup or memory reduction is established by source inspection.
The committed precision-fix baseline replaces the older knowingly failing Competitive baseline; all76 strict checks must still be freshly verified.
RSS confidence estimates describe the process distribution and do not remove startup/allocator noise or establish a bound on maximum memory.
Secondary targets share the original target thresholds but are reported separately from the two primary targets.
Partial retention is an explicitly scoped engineering decision; no percentage of worldwide competitiveness is inferred from passed cells.

rss_intervals.method: same paired percentile bootstrap,5000 resamples and separate one-sided95% endpoints, seed42017
rss_intervals.admission_role: Descriptive additional distribution evidence; unchanged observed maximum candidate/baseline<=1 remains the memory gate. No CI on future maximum is asserted.

required_before_launch: Archive exact final production patch and pristine baseline identity; same release configuration/example on both sides.
Archive final source-stable build/validation receipts and logs, exact binaries,toolchain/config/environment hashes.
Freeze plan,driver,shared runner/auditor,preflight wrapper/helper,fixture module,manifest/references,example,observer and helper source fingerprints before preflight.
Require audited passed-all-76 preflight and exact source/binary identity equality to the pending trial; externally pin final preflight report/receipt/guard/audit before each timed launch.
Pilot never accepts. Review it before authorizing the sole fixed fresh200pair confirmation; no source/parameter changes or interim analysis after launch.
Strict observed contention guard inside existing exclusive runner; final outer receipt binds report+guard. No foreign job is killed, no automatic postlaunch retry.

launch_contract.path_policy: Binary,source,output and observer evidence-directory arguments are absolute; scripts use the recorded repo-relative paths. This exact command chain is checked by the new audit wrapper.

candidate_patch.format: Zero-context unified diff; apply with git apply --unidiff-zero. Frozen before native build and all timing.

source_review: Literal five-segment reserve after first finite-point check; remaining validation, partial path state and work checks unchanged. Vec geometric capacity growth and allocation timing may differ before a later error. Public Rust reserve method retains documented standard capacity-overflow panic; PDF calls only request literal5.
